byte_ceiling_basis: Fixed 50-event page ceiling times 1 MiB declared per-event resource budget. Oversize, cursor, rule or schema failures are terminal; this resource budget is not a claim that every future response fits it.
question: Does the earliest deployed NFL full-game event in this fixed distinct future window contain a complete rule-identical total ladder whose side-specific Gamma acquisition proxy is strictly below its conditional one-unit floor?
selection: Choose earliest (startTime,slug,id) across the complete native bounded population before economic fields. Only its active full-game total ladders; never select a later sibling after failure. Require named teams, distinct native market/condition/token IDs and the full observed resolver/postponement/cancellation template. No midpoint fields are read.
adjudication_rule: One capture and one frozen zero-network classification. For lower<upper, Over(lower)+Under(upper) pays 1 outside the middle score interval, 2 inside it and 1 on common cancellation, conditional on consistent shared scoring/resolution. Require selected bestAsk and 1-bestBid; missing selected quotes never become zero. Rank all declared pairs by cost then thresholds and retain only strongest package plus complete counts. Gross surplus is not fee/depth, timing, recurrence, oracle-risk or cash qualification. No follow-up request is authorized by this contract, even if a gross candidate appears.
prior_scope_distinction: New native future deployment window outside all consumed September NFL/WNBA/CFB windows and exact events. Reuses rank-30 recurring monotone-payoff family, not a new mechanism; never retries their metadata, quotes or missing-price relations.
research_observation_count_effect: One terminal structural discovery observation if captured; no accepted mechanism or stable-edge effect.
